title: rosa micrantha var. lactiflora
intro: Rosa micrantha var. lactiflora, commonly known as the white rose or Rosa lactea, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its fragrant white flowers and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rosa micrantha var. lactiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
